jobs_results.title: Game Tester: Arabic
jobs_results.description:
Localsoft, S.L. is a world-class localization company offering translation, testing and audio services. From our headquarters in the Málaga TechPark in Málaga, Spain, we operate both locally and internationally with clients from many different business sectors including leading brands in the Games, IT, Legal and Business industries.

We are currently hiring Arabic (MSA) Language Game Testers to work in our HQ in Málaga, Spain.

If you have previous game testing experience or you are an avid gamer with excellent linguistic skills, we would like to hear from you!

As a Game Tester you will be testing games to detect and report grammar, spelling, punctuation and other linguistic and cultural errors in your native language.

Visit: www.localsoftgames.com

Responsibilities
• Follow company policy and values
• Follow established processes, instructions and QA checklists
• Take full ownership of each phase in the project life cycle
• Successfully complete tasks to the highest standards
• Be... aligned with Localsoft’s security and code of conduct
• Willingness to learn and improve, support other team members and go the extra mile

Requirements
• English with full working proficiency.
• Excellent native language skills
• Capacity to work in a multicultural, dynamic and deadline-driven work environment
• Good knowledge of game genres and platforms is a plus
• Good teamwork and interpersonal skills
• Proactive and positive “can do” attitude
• Understanding the importance of quality, customer service, confidentiality and security

Benefits
• Opportunity to work with a professional international team in a dynamic and friendly work environment
• Opportunity to work with renowned clients (publishers/developers)
• Cafeteria & Games
• Soft Drinks
• Fresh Fruit

Additional information
• Valid work permit for Spain is required
• Testing is performed in Localsoft’s secure testing lab in Málaga, Spain
• Remote work is not possible

jobs_results.title: QA TESTER
jobs_results.description:
Ref. IT – 33/2022

Oferta de empleo: QA Tester (Full Remote).

Nuestro cliente es una empresa IT de consultoría, servicios y desarrollo de software que trabaja en el ámbito de las Tecnologías de la Información con grandes corporaciones y multinacionales así como con aquellas empresas que, independientemente de su tamaño, pretenden innovar a través del uso racional de la tecnología.

Están especializados en Gestión de la Innovación, BI, Big Data, Análisis de Datos, Machine Learning y Data Analytics.

Seleccionamos para incorporarse a un proyecto indefinido a 1 QA TESTER y que participará en un proyecto desde cero de carácter internacional para el sector turístico y viajes.

Funciones:
• Probar historias de usuario / características como parte de las actividades de sprint.
• Diseñar especificaciones de prueba a través de historias de usuario.
• Utilizar herramientas de seguimiento de errores para su información (JIRA si es posible).
• Analizar los resultados de las pruebas y los reporta... a los roles de SCRUM
• Construir herramientas para apoyar el desarrollo y las funciones del negocio.
• Desarrollar herramientas de pruebas internas (marco) para mejorar los sistemas de calidad de las pruebas.
• Alertar cuando sea probable que un problema importante ponga en peligro todo el proyecto
• Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con los roles de garantía de calidad y otros departamentos para garantizar productos de calidad, con entregables y plazos claros del proyecto, y para garantizar la finalización oportuna de los entregables.
• Participar en un equipo pequeño, experimentado y enérgico en un cronograma de entrega rápido y ágil.

Skills:
• Entre 4 y 6 años de experiencia trabajando como QA Tester.
• Experiencia de entre 1 y 2 años con Selenium.
• Conocimientos o experiencia en Cypress, Postman, Rest Assured es un plus.
• Dispuesto a aprender y compartir conocimiento con el equipo de desarrollo.
• Experiencia en informes y documentación de problemas técnicos.
• Nivel de Inglés B2 o intermedio (sin certificar).

Valorable (NO OBLIGATORIO):
• Experiencia con GitHub u otras herramientas de CI/CD.
• Conocimientos en Python.
• Conocimientos en scripting.
• Conocimientos en testing multiplataforma

Se ofrece:
• Contratación directa e indefinida con nuestro cliente.
• Ubicación: Trabajo FULL REMOTE, podrás trabajar desde donde quieras.
• Salario: 36.000 – 42.000 euros brutos anuales.
• Formar parte de un proyecto profesional sólido y con futuro de una compañía en expansión.
• Formación a cargo de la empresa.

Si estás interesad@ puedes aplicar tu candidatura enviando tu CV a través del formulario de contacto de esta página.

¡Muchas gracias

jobs_results.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs_results.company_name: ING BANK NV SUCURSAL EN ESPAÑA
jobs_results.description: At ING we are looking for QA Automation Engineer Your role and work environment: We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic QA Automation Engineer to join our Release Team of Engineering Platform Tribe. The responsibility of this team is enforcing the release process, guaranteeing the feature(s) quality delivered to our customer while reducing our cycle time. Your key responsibilities: As a QA Automation Engineer, you will: Provide regular, detailed status report on project progress, including test cases executed, bugs discovered, and bugs fixed. Pushing the existing test strategy inside the company, through advocacy and leading by example. Develop test plans that approximate real-world environments and tools that assist in product validation. QA Engineers are also responsible for driving the development process toward quality-centric methodologies. What are we looking for? Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this... role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply! Good analytical and communication skills, ability to deliver technical information at all levels within the company. A team player working as a core member of a team. Close collaboration within and across the teams of the tribe. As a QA engineer, you must have: QA methodologies (e.g. shift left, test levels, test types). Experience in defining and designing test plans for acceptance criteria. Ability to automate operational process. Scripting (Python, Bash) Basic knowledge of relational data bases Create, configure and support CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps) Write and perform automated tests (functional, system, regression, and integration tests) Experience with Git including branching/merging workflows Knowledge of RESTful APIs Experience working with Public Clouds (Azure, GCP or AWS) Knowledge of tracking test coverage tools. English oral and written communication skills (B2 or higher). What do we offer? The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details. Check out what is waiting for you! Be flexible my friend. Our model is all about flexibility and accountability. Keeping both our customers and our colleagues needs in mind, you determine together which days you work at home and which you come to ING MAD to offer your best self. Do your thing. Restaurant card. So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings. Our house will be your home. In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more! Health insurance. For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children). Life insurance. We help you protect what matters most to you. Flexible remuneration. In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids… Free company shuttle. It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably. Banking benefits. Special loans with more beneficial conditions. Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank. And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us! More vitality and more belonging 360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose). Physiotherapy service on site. Runners club with your own trainer. Clinics with professional, world-class athletes. Gympass service. Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+) & Leonas. Get to know Us We are a team of more than 1600 people sharing one idea: doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go. A fully online bank where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with agile methodologies. And although we are based in Spain, we are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 40 countries. We are proud to have a diverse team and we are committed to continue developing a culture of Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging to foster a culture of collaboration and innovation that represents all collectives in the society. And even though we look orange on the outside, we are green on the inside. Our ambition in Sustainability is Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clints decide to embark on this journey. Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA. If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you! We hire people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on more responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself. With around 57,000 employees in over 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities. Show us initiative and we’ll let you make a difference. ING is a great place to join. We work in a highly dynamic environment where people are trusted to make decisions and every voice gets heard. If you have an idea how to make things better, you’ll be encouraged to make it happen – regardless of your position. We’d love to meet you

jobs_results.title: QA Lead
jobs_results.description:
SEEKING: QA Lead

We are looking for an experienced QALead who embodies both the spirit of mentorship and the acumen of a seasonedleader. The QA Leadwill helm a team of 3 QA specialists.

This role demands not just fluencyin English and a command over manual and automated testing techniques, but alsoa profound capability to initiate, oversee, and bring projects across thefinish line with unparalleled quality standards.

TASKS & RESPONSABILITIES

Core Responsibilities:
Test Planning and Execution: Craft comprehensive test plans that detail thetesting schedule, methodologies, and requirements to ensure the delivery ofvaluable insights to stakeholders. Lead by example in executing tests as perthe plan, working closely with developers to anticipate changes and addressbugs promptly.

Project Kickstarting and Leadership:

Spearhead the QA aspect of projectinitiation, collaborating closely with the development team to determinetesting needs early on. Manage and oversee the entire testing... lifecycle,ensuring seamless progress and the highest quality outcomes.

Process Improvement andDocumentation:

Conduct thorough audits of existingtesting processes, leading training sessions and creating enhancements based onbest practices. Review and maintain test documentation for accuracy,comprehensiveness, and compliance with all relevant standards.

Feedback and Reporting:

Provide critical feedback andsuggestions to developers and other stakeholders, aimed at elevating productquality. Regularly report on testing outcomes, issues encountered, and theresolution process to enable informed decision-making by management.

Stakeholder Collaboration and TestClosure:

Engage in productive collaborationwith all company stakeholders to align on expectations and deliverables. Ensuremeticulous test closure procedures are in place, verifying that products meetthe highest quality standards pre-release.

Metrics and Tracking:

Establish and maintain trackingmetrics to document every aspect of the testing process, facilitating futurereplication and continuous improvement.

Experience, Knowledge& Skills :

● Proven leadership experience inQA, with a solid track record of mentoring teams and leading successfulprojects.

● Expertise in both manual andautomated testing, including performance testing.
● Proficiency in test plan creation, documentation review, and test execution.
● Strong analytical skills and a keen eye for detail.
● Ability to multitask and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
● Certifications in Quality Assurance, Agile methodologies, or ProjectManagement.
● Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.
● Knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#.

Education :

● Bachelor's degree in ComputerScience, Information Technology, or related field

Language :

● Fluent in English with exceptionalcommunication skills.

WE OFFER:

· Full-time Freelance contract

· Rate: €240 / €264 per day + VAT (according tothe experience provided)

· Long-Term Project (mínimum 5 years)

· Location: Spain - 100% teleworking

· Desired start date: ASAP

jobs_results.title: QA Architect (Web / Mobile)
jobs_results.description:
QA Architect (Web/Mobile)

Job Summary

Estamos buscando un Arqitecto QA excepcional para trabajar con nuestro equipo multifuncional y unirse a nuestra comunidad de expertos de clase mundial. Trabajará en proyectos emocionantes con nuestros clientes, asumiendo el papel esencial de asesorar a nuestros clientes sobre la calidad del software que se está probando. Además, trabajará con nuestros clientes para asesorarlos de manera proactiva sobre cómo acelerar y mejorar el proceso de QE&A.

Key Responsibilities

Liderar un equipo de QA encargado de realizar las pruebas de integración de Sistemas E2E, tanto manuales como automáticas, desde su diseño hasta su cierre.

· Liderar la definición e implementación de soluciones avanzadas de automatización de pruebas (funcionales y no funcionales) y su inclusión en los ciclos de integración/entrega/despliegue continuo.

· Establecer la dirección técnica del trabajo de los equipos de QA a su cargo y dirigir el equipo de automatización de pruebas.

·... Seguimiento de métricas del proceso, elaborando informes, gestionando dependencias, riesgos y bloqueos hasta su resolución

· Presentación de informes a las partes interesadas del proyecto

· Revisar los procesos de QA existentes, recomendar mejoras y definir acciones para implantarlos

· Proporcionar soporte experto y formación a los miembros del equipo

Job Requirements

Essential skills:

+ 10 años de profesional de QA y +6 años en automatización (UI y API)

+ 3 años de exitosa trayectoria como Arquitecto QA con experiencia en el diseño e implementación de soluciones de automatización, virtualización de servicios e integración de sistemas desde 0 y bajo un enfoque de Continuous Testing

Experiencia en automatización para aplicaciones web y móvil

Experiencia en la gestión de los procesos de QA, análisis de riesgos, planificación de recursos y la estimación de proyectos.

Relevantes experiencias en entornos como:

· Profundos conocimientos de programación: Java, Spring Boot

· Fuerte Experiencia en Xray y Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Jenkins

· BDD – Cucumber · CI/CD: Jenkins, Openshift, Azure

· Gatling

Fuertes capacidades de comunicación y reporting

Emprendedor y gran capacidad de networking.

Foco en excelencia operacional, responsable y orientado a resultados

Autodirigido, independiente y cómodo en entornos de trabajo de ritmo rápido, ambiguos y a menudo multidireccionales.

Fluido Inglés hablado y escrito

Experiencia en trabajo en entornos multiculturales

Nice to have skills:

Experiencia en eCommerce y Retail

Experiencia en desarrollar y mantener un modelo de planificación que estime el ROI de la automatización de pruebas y Realizar un seguimiento e informe del retorno de la inversión real

Abierto a Abierto para viajes de clientes según sea necesario
